entries.name: ccf-core-0.1.1
entries.description: Portable Record/Link/Blob objects, split compartments, canonical hashing, admission journal, lineages, baseline governance, mindpack restore/merge, and projection rules.
security_claims: prefix integrity when commit verification succeeds
exclusions: does not claim selective cryptographic erasure
does not claim rollback freshness without a witness

entries.name: ccf-local-sync-0.1.1
entries.description: Offline signed producer-batch chains, resumable delta packs, device credentials, provisional local state, and batched synchronization.
security_claims: authenticated offline provenance when credentials and signatures verify
exclusions: offline revocation cannot affect a disconnected device until it learns new state

entries.name: ccf-archive-encryption-derived-v1
entries.description: One random archive epoch secret wrapped to authorized recipients; per-object compartment keys derived locally with HKDF.
security_claims: provider-blind storage when no service recipient key slot exists
epoch-wide cryptographic erasure when every recoverable epoch secret is destroyed
exclusions: does not provide selective per-object cryptographic erasure

entries.name: ccf-object-erasure-v1
entries.description: Random per-object data-encryption keys and wrapped-key inventory for selective cryptographic erasure.
security_claims: selective cryptographic erasure when all wrapped-key and backup copies are destroyed
exclusions: requires stronger key-custody and recovery operations

entries.name: ccf-witnessed-integrity-v1
entries.description: Independent head checkpoints or witness signatures for rollback detection beyond valid-prefix integrity.
security_claims: rollback detection relative to trusted witness checkpoints

entries.name: ccf-succession-v1
entries.description: Live signer rotation and preauthorized successor activation.
security_claims: verifiable signer continuity across authorized rotation or succession

entries.name: ccf-continuity-pack-0.1.1
entries.description: Episodes, preferences, values, goals, commitments, boundaries, and relationships.

entries.name: ccf-agent-pack-0.1.1
entries.description: Framework-neutral agent runs, findings, handoffs, proposals, and receipts.
